$comment: THE ORIGINS SPIER IS DEPLOYED AT. One file, imported by every module that
needs one and gated against every config that must repeat one.
Four Workers and one GitHub Pages site, all on personal/project accounts
until the project has a domain. Before this file the same five strings were
typed into nine places across seven source files, and each rename (the CDS
split, the clinical Worker) found them one at a time. Code imports
`@spier/core/lib/deployOrigins` (or this file relatively, where no alias
reaches); `services/*/wrangler.jsonc` cannot import, so its copies are
Values are ORIGINS — scheme + host, no trailing slash — except `pages`,
which carries the repository path GitHub Pages serves under. Build the
URL you need from them; do not add a URL here.
An adopter deploying SPiER replaces these with their own. They are not
secrets; they are the same strings a browser's address bar shows.
